context:
Goal: nobody reads the old Card in Hand design page as the current look.
Problem (risk): the design page differs from main in nine ways, and the note at its top names only five; a reader could take the four unlisted ones as still current, and only you say how much the note must carry.
Based on (read): the designer drew the note and a hideable group for the four others: keys spanning the fold, the Suspense box order, and the two questions still open on the page for the entry tab and the post order.
Departs from: main has no such note — this adds a note at the top of the design page that lists what later rulings override.
Waiting on: your answer on the Card in Hand design page question. This matters only if you pick merge it as a reference.

options.gain: A reader sees every difference at once.
options.how: The note also lists the four others, two of them still open.
options.label: List all nine differences
options.lose: Two lines go stale when the open questions close.

why: The two open questions will change, so a list that names them is wrong within days.
